authenticate.pathway: bearer = token from ~/.traycer/cli/credentials, in memory only; on UNAUTHORIZED run `traycer whoami --json` and re-read the file
authenticate.evidence: every live call succeeded with the stored token; the whoami refresh path is unit-tested against a fake host (no live UNAUTHORIZED happened)

versionNegotiation.evidence: openAck: 113 floor + 257 optional host methods; client offers 476; chat.subscribe negotiated 1.41

hostCapabilities.evidence: capabilities ["unary.idempotencyKey"]; runtime chatMessageList=available (license key value withheld)

listAgents.pathway: epic.listChatRecords + epic.listTuiAgents (no sender agent needed) + epic.getChatRunSettingsBatch, normalized to {agentId, surface, harnessId, model, ...}
listAgents.evidence: ab47a5cf: 1 tui/claude row, matches `traycer agent list --json --all`; 243c50b9: gui/claude/haiku + gui/codex/gpt-5.6-luna

chatEvents.pathway: chat.subscribe via vendored ChatStreamClient (snapshot, actionAck, messageAccepted, turnStateChanged, blockDelta, ...)

sendPromptGuiChat.pathway: chat.subscribe client frame kind:send, sender {type:user}, settings copied from epic.getChatRunSettings, accountContext PERSONAL, sentFromHostId = local hostId; correlate actionAck by clientActionId, messageAccepted by messageId, turnStateChanged by activeTurn.userMessageId
sendPromptGuiChat.evidence: T2 claude haiku and T3 codex gpt-5.6-luna: one ack, one user turn, reply equals the marker, model unchanged

sendPromptTuiAgent.pathway: agent.sendMessage@1.1 {senderAgentId, epicId, receiverAgentId, prompt, responseId:null, expectReply:false, workspace:null} as a sender agent in the receiver's own task (adapter option a2aSender), idempotencyKey fm1-a2a-<requestId>; delivery and reply observed through agent.getTranscript. Never terminal.subscribe write.
sendPromptTuiAgent.scope: Claude Code TUI agents whose Claude session runs the Traycer inbox monitor. Codex TUI: refused (TARGET_TUI_UNSUPPORTED). A Claude TUI blocked at the folder-trust dialog accepts the RPC but never receives the message.
sendPromptTuiAgent.evidence: reports/evidence/tui-a2a/ (2026-11-18): RPC 15-51 ms, prompt in receiver transcript ~1.0 s, reply ~3.0-4.1 s; tools/smoke-traycer TUI-A2A PASS (reports/evidence/tui-a2a/smoke-2026-11-18T11-10-24Z/records.json)

interAgentMessage.evidence: protocol/src/host/agent/shared.ts docstring; not used for human prompts

transcript.evidence: used to verify T2/T3 turn counts and markers

a2aReplyCapture.pathway: expectReply=true returns a broker responseId (reused per sender->receiver pair: 40b9ef8f… twice); the receiver must call traycer_send_message to reply
a2aReplyCapture.evidence: haiku receiver answered in its own transcript but sent no a2a reply; on an explicit request its Claude auto-mode classifier denied traycer_send_message ('Unsanctioned Communication'). agent.inbox.subscribe for a GUI sender: UNAUTHORIZED AGENT_NOT_FOUND; for a TUI agent the fm1-console client may open it (would race that agent's own monitor). Adapter reads the reply from the receiver transcript instead (details.reply).

a2aGuiReceiver.evidence: lands as a user_message 'Agent message from FM1 Console ...' (RPC 521 ms); the adapter keeps GUI chats on chat.subscribe send (user sender, exact turn correlation)
